mobile.account_routing.title.note: Section heading in computer settings; not a provider/model picker.

mobile.account_routing.scope.note: Scope note below the selected computer; never imply a phone-global routing policy.

mobile.account_routing.disconnected.note: No usable selected-route client; do not call the relay outdated or claim an empty policy.

mobile.account_routing.loading.note: Read in flight; no policy choice is asserted before the backend answers.

mobile.account_routing.save.note: Explicitly saves this temporary draft to the selected computer only.

mobile.account_routing.saving.note: Write pending; never a saved confirmation.

mobile.account_routing.saved.note: Only after a validated response confirms the requested value on the same route.

mobile.account_routing.unsaved.note: A selected draft differs from the backend value; changing radio alone does not persist.

mobile.account_routing.retry.note: Retry a failed read; not a blind automatic retry of an uncertain save.

mobile.account_routing.reload.note: After an uncertain or rejected save: GET the computer's committed policy and replace the draft; never repeat the write blindly.

mobile.account_routing.unavailable.note: Confirmed missing relay route only; never use for an offline/unknown tunnel.

mobile.account_routing.load_error.note: Read failed for another reason, distinct from a confirmed old relay.

mobile.account_routing.error.note: Unknown save outcome or mismatched confirmation; do not assert not-saved or success.

mobile.account_routing.rejected.note: Definitive backend refusal; preserve any backend error text separately, not as a descriptor.
